External services

Third-party services

Last updated: November 2, 2026

Versa Player may interact with external services only when the corresponding feature is available and used.

Google Play Billing

Involved in app distribution, Versa Premium one-time purchase and restoration, and purchase-state verification. See the Google Privacy Policy.

Google Mobile Ads (AdMob)

Displays native or interstitial advertising in the free edition when the relevant configuration and privacy choices allow it. See Google Advertising & Privacy.

Google User Messaging Platform (UMP)

Presents and manages advertising-related privacy and consent choices where applicable under regional regulations.

Internet radio (Radio Browser)

Versa Player queries the community directory Radio Browser and connects directly to the server of the station selected by the user. Stations and their content are independent of Versa Player.

Device voice services

Speech recognition when the user taps the search microphone depends on the service configured in Android and on that provider's policies.

Manual web search

For lyrics or artwork, Versa Player may open a browser or web search at the user's explicit request. Versa Player does not automatically extract content from those pages. The browser and search provider process the search query under their own policies.

Listing a service here does not imply ownership, affiliation, sponsorship or endorsement by that provider unless expressly stated.
